findings_resolved.finding: Whole-ledger preflight had a race before migration lock; concurrent unknown receipt could still permit pending SQL.
findings_resolved.reproduction: Independent synthetic Node24 SQLite interleaving produced openedDespiteUnknownLedger=true and pendingPublicReviewsApplied=1 before correction.
findings_resolved.resolution: Whole ledger revalidated under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; pending SQL, receipts and auth DDL share one transaction. Unknown/checksum concurrent changes, valid concurrent completion and all-pending rollback regressions pass.

findings_resolved.finding: Latest-generation GET checks without single-flight could discard every slow poll when response time exceeds interval.
findings_resolved.resolution: Public polling and owner refresh now single-flight; deferred-handler tests cross repeated polling calls.

findings_resolved.finding: Notification dispatch finally could clear busy for a later owner mutation while its post-dispatch refresh was pending.
findings_resolved.resolution: Dispatch clears its busy state before refresh; regression confirms later mutation remains busy.
